Eclipse Dial
The greatest weapon of the void 
beings waits only for humanoid blood!
A giant glass dome clings to the 
mountains like the eye of an evil god. 
Inside, a great wheel waits for blood so 
it can attune itself to this dimension's 
cosmic frequencies. Then, with one 
turn, the wheel blots out the sun and 
begins the void being invasion!
